record.question: What was the basic objective of the various measures, taken by the British Government at Calcutta, in the field of internal trade from time to time?
options: To create a local market for British manufacturers
To help establish the monopoly of the company and its servants over inland trade
To realize the maximum possible revenues from regulation and control of Indian trade
record.explanation: British measures aimed at company monopoly over inland trade.
